overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board Chair addressed a School Committee meeting during open participation but did not communicate with other Board members, so no deliberation occurred. Resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly deliberated on public business outside an open meeting through oral communication at a School Committee meeting on June 12, 2012.
